title: Silicon Sample Benchmark — Tier 1 (individual simulation) submission (team team_31)

creators.name: Holtdirk, Tobias
creators.affiliation: LMU Munich, SODA Lab (Social Data Science and AI Lab)

description: Direct forecast of the megastudy's 16 x 13 treatment-effect table by a single stateless LLM completion (claude-opus-5, 3 draws, cell-wise median) given the verbatim intervention texts, item wordings and sample description; control levels and subgroup offsets anchored on public surveys; Tier-1 rows synthesised backwards from the predicted table. Calibration multiplier fitted on 13 held-out published experiments but deliberately not applied (policy 'none'). No human edited any prediction.
